remarks: Set along a single-loaded cul-de-sac in the sought-after Talega community of San Clemente, 20 Via Paquete is a beautifully reimagined residence where sophisticated design, thoughtful functionality and a peaceful canyon setting come together effortlessly. Recently transformed inside and out by Jane Stier Interiors, this six-bedroom, three-bath home has been curated with a warm, elevated aesthetic that feels both luxurious and exceptionally livable. Step inside to light-filled interiors grounded by gorgeous salt-washed European oak flooring, designer lighting and a fresh, refined palette. At the heart of the home, the completely redesigned kitchen showcases custom cabinetry and beautifully selected finishes, creating an inviting gathering space that flows seamlessly into the surrounding living and entertaining areas. The bathrooms have been equally transformed with sophisticated materials and a clean, timeless design, while new carpeting, updated windows and carefully selected fixtures complete the interior. The floor plan offers exceptional flexibility, with two bedrooms and a full bathroom on the main level—ideal for overnight guests, multigenerational living, a private office or fitness space. Three additional bedrooms and a spacious dual-sink bathroom complete the upper level. Also upstairs, the primary suite is a serene retreat featuring dual walk-in closets, a spa-inspired remodeled bathroom and a private balcony overlooking the canyon. The transformation continues outdoors, where fresh exterior paint, redesigned landscaping, refinished concrete and a renovated outdoor kitchen create a beautiful extension of the living space. Whether hosting friends for dinner, relaxing outdoors or simply taking in the tranquil canyon surroundings, the setting captures the effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle for which Southern California is known. A two-car garage with additional storage adds everyday practicality, while the Talega location places you close to the community’s celebrated amenities, parks, trails and recreation, with San Clemente’s beaches, charming downtown, restaurants and coastal lifestyle just minutes away. Thoughtfully redesigned, beautifully finished and positioned in one of Talega’s most desirable settings, 20 Via Paquete offers the rare opportunity to move into a home where the work has already been done—and simply enjoy everything that makes living in San Clemente so special.

remarks: Nestled on just under 25 acres of premier wine country, this exceptional Santa Ynez vineyard compound offers a blend of luxury, privacy, and viticultural prestige-- all nestled behind gates, and ripe with opportunity for a vintner to continue its legacy. Positioned in one of the most coveted corridors of the Santa Ynez Valley, this estate offers the perfect blend of luxury living and agricultural opportunity, just minutes from acclaimed restaurants, tasting rooms, and the vibrant lifestyle of Los Olivos and Santa Ynez.

remarks: Perched above Friendship Park on the high side of Mendocino Village, the historic Spencer Hills House has quietly presided over the coastal landscape since 1855. One of the village's most distinguished Victorian residences, the home sits on a remarkable 1.2-acre parcel, an uncommon expanse within the historic district, with layered views across village rooftops, classic water towers, the mouth of Big River, and the Pacific Ocean beyond.Recognized by fans around the world as the home of Cabot Cove's beloved physician, Dr. Seth Hazlitt, the property appeared in the iconic television series Murder, She Wrote. For admirers of the long-running show, the residence remains a familiar part of Mendocino's cinematic identity and adds a memorable cultural chapter to its long history.Architecturally, Spencer Hills House reflects the craftsmanship of early Mendocino builders. Distinctive custom milled trim unique to the residence highlights the artistry of the period. Interior ceiling heights are notably generous for a Victorian of this vintage, creating spaces that feel open and welcoming. Expansive windows capture changing coastal light and illuminate wide plank wood floors and preserved period details that lend warmth and authenticity throughout the interiors.The home has benefited from significant recent upgrades and repairs completed with exceptional attention to quality and detail. These improvements enhance comfort, performance, and longevity while remaining harmonious with the home's historic character and architectural fabric.Outdoor living unfolds across the property's expansive grounds. A generous deck provides an exceptional setting for outdoor dining and entertaining above the village, framed by coastal cypress and distant ocean horizons. A thoughtfully designed bocce court set in surrounding flagstone offers a relaxed gathering space well suited to Mendocino's coastal lifestyle.A two car garage provides everyday practicality with cedar lined storage, wine space, and EV wiring. A separate non historic barn on the northwest corner of the parcel comes with approved plans and permits to bring it into compliance, offering future flexibility consistent with Mendocino Historic Review Board standards.From the front door, Mendocino Village is just moments away, with galleries, restaurants, cafes, and coastal trails easily reached on foot. Spencer Hills House represents a rare opportunity to own one of Mendocino's landmark residences.

Welcome to 101 Score. A standout offering in the award-winning Great Park Neighborhoods of Irvine, designed around a simple idea: the busier life gets, the more your home should restore you. Positioned on a corner lot at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac with just one neighboring home and open space on two sides, this is the privacy and breathing room that's hard to come by in a community this coveted.
This meticulously designed 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom residence blends sophisticated style with the everyday livability busy families actually need— starting with TWO primary suites, one conveniently on the main level and one upstairs, alongside two additional bedroom suites. Multi-generational living, or a live-in nanny- the floor plan flexes with your family.
The wellness story here is the real headline. At the end of a long day, the downstairs primary suite becomes your personal spa: a soaking tub, dual shower heads, and a Mr. Steam spa shower with multi-nozzle steam, built-in aromatherapy (eucalyptus or lavender on demand), and an infrared sauna light for full recovery-mode immersion. And the wellness works even when you're not thinking about it: a whole-home Fresh-Aire UV APCO-X Ultra Air Treatment system purifies every breath with UV light and activated carbon — eliminating bacteria, viruses, mold, and VOCs at the source — while a whole-home water purification system means every glass from every tap is filtered and clean. Instant hot water arrives on demand, and a tankless water heater delivers an endless supply.
The open-concept kitchen keeps the household running. Built-in stainless steel Monogram appliances anchor the space: a 6-burner gas range with integrated flat top grill, a built-in double oven, and a built-in refrigerator, all flowing around a generous island with self-closing drawers and built-in trash. A walk-in pantry handles every storage need. The living room is anchored by a stunning floor-to-ceiling quartz fireplace, the flat screen television conveys, and built-in speakers with full surround sound make this room ready for family movies.
The wrap-around yard features a luxury marble waterfall fountain, lush turf throughout, a built-in BBQ, fridge, wine fridge and sink, raised garden boxes, string lights plus an extraordinary mini private orchard — lime, pomegranate, fig, lemon, orange, mango, and avocado trees. Leased solar keeps energy costs low, a fire sprinkler system, a hardwired security system, and a Tesla fast charger check every box.

remarks:
A study in poise and refinement, this residence emerges as a quiet yet commanding statement—a one of a kind Masterpiece by Tailor Brothers, whose work consistently aspires to redefine the language of luxury living. The structure does not clamor for attention; rather, it draws the eye through balance, proportion, and an assured confidence in its own craftsmanship, inviting admiration through subtlety instead of spectacle.

Here, affluence is not declared, but revealed—layer by deliberate layer. Spanning more than 3,100 square feet across three thoughtfully arranged stories, the home unfolds like a carefully curated gallery. Each space offers a vignette of material, texture, and light, guiding the observer through an experience that feels both intimate and expansive.

From the main living area and its elevated mezzanine, the home extends its narrative outward—where, at dusk, the distant lights of Palos Verdes shimmer across the horizon like a living tapestry, a quiet spectacle that transforms the everyday into something cinematic. It is a view not merely seen, but experienced, adding a sense of place that is both grounding and transportive.

The walnut flooring, rich in tone and continuous in its flow, grounds the interiors with warmth and quiet permanence. In contrast, surfaces of Taj Mahal quartzite introduce a luminous softness, their delicate veining reminiscent of natural landscapes. These refined materials carry through the kitchen and baths, creating a cohesive dialogue between utility and artistry.

There is a tactile poetry to the finishes: plumbing fixtures of a caliber rarely encountered, evoking the understated opulence of homes valued far beyond; cabinetry in European white oak, its pale grain catching and reflecting light with gentle elegance; and a sculptural walnut island that anchors the kitchen as both a functional centerpiece and a work of design.

Above, designer light fixtures hover like curated installations, casting a considered glow that evolves throughout the day, animating each surface and shadow. Every element has been selected with intention—nothing excessive, nothing incidental—resulting in a harmony that feels effortless yet deeply deliberate.

This is not simply a home, but a composition—an exploration of understated elegance elevated to its highest form. A singular work, crafted for those who understand that true distinction lies not in excess, but in the mastery of detail, proportion, and enduring design.

remarks: Welcome to the good life at Griffin Ranch, where resort style amenities, spacious living, and a garage that will make car enthusiasts do a double take come together in one exceptional La Quinta home. Situated on just over half an acre, this approximately 4,700 square foot Plan 7 residence offers four bedrooms, including two generous primary suites, five bathrooms, and a versatile game or bonus room. Designed with both everyday comfort and entertaining in mind, the spacious floor plan provides room for everyone to gather, along with plenty of places to escape for a little quiet time. The kitchen is ready for the cook in the family with custom countertops, a large farmhouse sink, a complete suite of Thermador appliances, and generous workspace. Oversized tile flooring throughout was a substantial upgrade that adds both style and practicality. The two primary suites offer exceptional comfort, with one featuring a freestanding soaking tub and the other a distinctive shower combination. A separate sitting room opens to the pool and spa, creating a peaceful retreat within the home.Outside, the east facing entertainment area is made for desert living. Epoxy flooring, a split system air conditioner, and a whole home soft water system add to the impressive functionality. Whether your passion is cars, projects, or simply having space for everything, this garage delivers. Life at Griffin Ranch extends well beyond your front door. Residents enjoy access to an impressive clubhouse, fitness center, Pilates room, game room with pool table and table tennis, tennis and pickleball courts, bocce ball courts, scenic walking paths, and a dog park. It is a community designed for an active, social, and relaxed desert lifestyle, with amenities that make every day feel a little more like a vacation. You are close to world class golf, hiking & biking trails, shopping, dining, & entertainment at Acrisure Arena. A rare combination of generous living space, garage capacity, and the amenities of Griffin Ranch.

remarks: Provence in Topanga: A Villa Carved from Time. Perched above the canyon's shifting light, your French villa rises like a dream transported from an older world, where stone, timber, and craft were the true measure of luxury. Designed by architect Cary Gepner, this home is rooted with deep caissons in centuries of European tradition, all while embracing the wild romance of Topanga. Sweeping cross-canyon views entrance, sheltered by a roof sheathed in over 400 year old Provencal tiles. A rooftop deck captures panoramic vistas across Topanga's rolling mountains and endless skies. Stepping through a handcrafted mesquite door, the home reveals an interior alive with color, texture, and history. A tiled staircase ascends to a dramatic Great Room where soaring beamed ceilings and towering windows frame the mountains beyond. An antique Egyptian chandelier hangs overhead. Saltillo floors mingle with hand-painted tiles from India, Malibu, and Catalina, while massive 200 year old Manchurian doors with sliding timber bars open to a sheltering loggia near a dancing fountain. Lounge before the living room's carved marble fireplace, surrounded by doors leading to wrap-around decks. Thick plaster lime washed walls, antique sconces, and arched passages create rooms that feel collected over generations. Prepare pizza in the wood fired pizza oven, in a kitchen graced with deeply veined pink travertine counters and copper sinks, handcrafted cabinetry, an antique carved marble hood, and a wood-burning pizza oven, that evoke the warmth of a French farmhouse. Throughout the home, marble mosaic tile embedded "rugs" from Aleppo and Damascus add artistry and permanence underfoot. Walk through an enfilade of arched doorways to the primary suite, where a travertine-framed window captures cinematic views of the canyon. remarks: Runway Living Meets Country Charm. Experience a rare opportunity to own one of SoCal's unique aviation properties—an upgraded, runway-direct custom home with a private airplane hangar on a 2.69-acre fully fenced parcel in the beautiful aviation and equestrian community of Lake Riverside Estates. Surrounded by mature pines and an impressive orchard of 48 fruit trees, this property blends aviation convenience with peaceful country living. The all-level acreage provides possibilities for future improvements, whether you envision an additional hangar, workshop, RV storage, horse facilities, or simply room to enjoy the open space. The well-maintained residence offers a bright, welcoming interior with new vinyl flooring and complete exterior stucco, paint, and roof replacement in May 2024. The functional floor plan features two bedrooms and a full bathroom on the main level, along with a spacious living room, kitchen, and dining area. Upstairs, the private primary suite serves as a tranquil retreat, complete with a cozy wood-burning stove and mountain/treetop views framed by large picture windows. Two outdoor balconies and a rear concrete patio create inviting spaces to relax and take in the natural beauty. Aviation enthusiasts will appreciate the direct runway access and aircraft hangar, complete with a permitted apartment; also improved in 2024 with new stucco, paint and roof. The hangar accommodates most private aircraft; the hangar door measures approximately 37'4" wide by 9'11" high. Pride of ownership is evident throughout the property, with numerous system improvements including replaced water heaters in both the home and hangar apartment, serviced electrical systems, well and septic maintenance, and automated irrigation servicing the orchard. Additional features include an attached three-car garage, concrete driveway, taxiway and sidewalk. At approximately 3,400 feet in elevation, Lake Riverside Estates offers an unmatched lifestyle with miles of riding trails, a private 55-acre lake, equestrian arena, sports courts, and a vibrant aviation community. The community's 3,600-foot paved and lighted runway (54CL) features VASI guidance and a recently added AWOS weather reporting system, making arrivals and departures both convenient and accessible. Properties of this caliber are seldom available. Combining acreage, direct runway access, a private hangar, upgrades, and lifestyle, this is a truly exceptional opportunity to own a hidden aviation treasure.

This masterfully crafted, modern French Country estate is located in prestigious North Arcadia within the award-winning Arcadia Unified School District. Designed by renowned architect Robert Tong and constructed by Rodeo Construction, this exceptional residence offers approximately 9,303 square feet of luxurious living space on a rare, flat 52,403-square-foot lot, equiped with solar panels (all paid off).
Beyond the dramatic pivot front door, the home makes an unforgettable first impression with its extraordinary craftsmanship, thoughtful floor plan, and meticulous attention to detail throughout. Elegant porcelain tile flooring, marble accent walls, designer fixtures, solid wood doors, and rich wood-framed openings and windows beautifully define each space.
The residence features 6 bedrooms and 7 bathrooms, including a spectacular primary suite with two expansive, elegantly appointed walk-in closets. A private library provides a sophisticated retreat, while the grand living room, highlighted by a striking marble accent wall, serves as the centerpiece of the home, gracefully connecting both wings of the residence.
One wing is dedicated to entertainment and leisure, featuring a theater/entertainment room, wine room & cigar room, a indoor gym with sauna. The opposite wing houses the bedrooms, offering privacy and comfort for family and guests. The open gourmet kitchen is appointed with marble slab countertops and top-of-the-line Sub-Zero appliances, complemented by a separate Chinese wok kitchen. Additional living spaces include a formal dining room with porcelain tile flooring and a spacious family room with a beautiful fireplace overlooking the backyard.
Designed for seamless indoor-outdoor living, the estate showcases a serene garden courtyard, a koi pond surrounded by Japanese-inspired landscaping, a zero-edge pool and spa, and an expansive covered outdoor patio ideal for family gatherings and entertaining guests.
A rare offering of elegance, scale, and craftsmanship, this North Arcadia estate represents luxury living at its finest.

remarks: Tucked into the natural bouldering and sweeping mountain views of Warner Springs, this beautifully maintained 2011-built manufactured home offers 1,112 square feet of comfortable single-level living, set on a permanent 433A foundation. Situated directly across from the community's tranquil middle pond and its center fountain, the home invites you to relax on the front porch and take in the gentle sound of moving water, a peaceful backdrop to everyday life. Inside and out, thoughtful upgrades bring lasting comfort and peace of mind. The home has been earthquake retrofitted and features roof fire sprinklers, a new air conditioning system, and new LED lighting throughout. The kitchen and baths showcase solid wood cabinetry with updated fixtures, while the private deck, enhanced with a lockable gate and ceiling fan, offers an ideal spot to unwind. A covered carport with a 2-car tandem cement driveway and a new storage shed round out the home's easy, low-maintenance appeal. Experience the beauty of all four seasons right here in Southern California, where you can enjoy outdoor activities year-round. Just a short walk from the Stone Ridge Community Clubhouse, you'll have access to an array of amenities including a swimming pool, spa, fitness area, billiards, library, piano, chef's kitchen, and regular social events. Nature is woven into daily life here, with catch-and-release fishing ponds home to ducks, turtles, and abundant wildlife, all set among mature trees and natural beauty. Local hiking and horse trails, plus the nearby North Mountain Wine Trail, offer easy access to some of the region's finest wineries and vineyards. Aviation enthusiasts will also appreciate the nearby Warner Springs Gliderport, and the community sits close to the Sunshine Summit Fire Station #59. When you need shopping, dining, or medical and dental services, Temecula is about 35 minutes away, with Santa Ysabel and Ramona within a comfortable drive as well. The charming mountain town of Julian, known for its apple pies and small-town character, makes for an easy day trip. Escape the hustle and bustle of city life and embrace a tranquil lifestyle surrounded by nature's beauty. Select personal property, including the laundry room freezer, cabinet, and water filtration system, are excluded from the sale but may be negotiated separately outside of escrow. Furniture and wall hangings are also negotiable outside of escrow. Don't miss this opportunity to call Warner Springs home and experience the joy of mountain living at its finest.

Country Living with Room for Animals, Hobbies & More — Plus a Studio ADU!

Bring your horses, goats, or other animals and enjoy the freedom of country living on this fully fenced and cross-fenced 1+ acre mini farm. Built in 2007, this spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bath manufactured home offers 1,556 square feet of comfortable living space, plus a separate studio ADU that adds valuable flexibility and potential rental income.

Inside the main home, you'll find an open floor plan with solid wood cabinetry, granite countertops, and plenty of space for family and friends to gather. The primary suite features a spacious bathroom with dual sinks, granite countertops, a jetted soaking tub, and a separate full-size shower.

One of the property's standout features is the studio ADU located above the barn, stall, and covered animal area. This private additional living space could be ideal for a caretaker, guest quarters, extended family, home office, or rental opportunity—providing flexibility for your lifestyle or the potential to generate additional income.

The property is designed for both functionality and versatility. A large steel detached two-car shop/garage provides ample room for vehicles, equipment, storage, or hobbies. The barn and covered animal area include a stall and round pen, making the property well suited for those wanting space for livestock, horses, or other animals.

A concrete retaining wall behind the shop creates additional level parking, with room for RVs, trailers, or extra vehicles. Gated access, fencing, cross-fencing, animal facilities, the detached shop, and the studio ADU make this property a rare combination of comfortable living space and practical amenities.

Whether you're looking for a mini farm, hobby property, place for animals, rental income, or space for a caretaker, this property offers the flexibility to make it work for you—all while enjoying the privacy and freedom of country living.

remarks: A Triumph of Modern Elegance in Pelican Hill, Presenting 7 Sailview, a newly completed architectural masterpiece within the revered guard-gated enclave of Pelican Hill in Newport Coast. Commanding a prominent position on an expansive premium parcel, the residence offers unobstructed views of the Pacific Ocean, Catalina Island, Newport Harbor, and twinkling City lights from nearly every room. A sweeping circular motor court sets a tone of arrival, leading into interiors that exude understated opulence and architectural integrity. No detail has been overlooked from stunning custom chandelier systems, custom three story steel staircase, as well as exceptional architecture boasting a true open concept. Expansive Fleetwood motorized pocket doors seamlessly connect interior living spaces to the resort-style exterior, offering a lifestyle of effortless indoor-outdoor living. Spanning over ~10,600 square feet, the home is thoughtfully designed with 7 lavish bedroom suites and 9 impeccably appointed oversized bathrooms. The residence is highlighted by a dream primary bathroom clad in Calcutta stone featuring a solid Calcutta stone floating bathtub, owners private outdoor terrace, and bespoke designer dual closets. Amenities rivaling the world’s finest resorts include a state-of-the-art theater, professional-grade gym, executive office, and full-service hair salon. Outdoors, the grounds are a private sanctuary — featuring a sleek zero-edge pool and spa with Rolls Royce themed Starlight bottom, outdoor kitchen, multiple fire features, lush landscaping, multiple covered loggias + terraces, and balcony spaces all framed by panoramic coastal views and the golden hues of Southern California sunsets. Moments from world-class Pelican Resort and Golf Club, beaches, luxury resorts, fine dining, and exceptional schooling options, 7 Sailview represents a once-in-a-generation opportunity to own one of the region’s most distinguished newly built estates — where every element is elevated and perfectly executed, where no compromise has been made.

Secluded single-story log-style home featuring a stunning panoramic view. With 20.89 acres of picturesque rolling hills, this mini-ranch offers endless possibilities for enjoying the wonders of nature and for generating different sources of income. Currently, a portion of this mini-ranch is being developed as an exotic fruit farm featuring a number of exotic fruits such as guava, Australian custard apple, Israeli custard apple, banana, orange, peach, jujube, java, sapote, mango, longan, tangerine, berry, berry, rolia, lemon, and sakara flower. Nevertheless, there is plenty of room on these extensive acres for animals like horses, goats, alpacas, and fish.

remarks: The Judge & Jeannie Anderson Residence, Aaron G. Green FAIA (1959). An oceanfront estate property of nearly 3.5 acres with magnificent views of the Pacific Ocean, Abalone Cove, and Catalina Island. One of Frank Lloyd Wright's most talented and original disciples, Green ran his own distinguished practice while serving as Wright's West Coast representative from 1951 until the elder architect died in 1959. The Anderson Residence is one of Green's finest works- an important and almost entirely intact example of his Organic Modernism. "True, there is a roof overhead, and there are walls and mullions supporting it," Curtis Besinger wrote for House Beautiful Magazine (1963). "But these do not seem so much to shut in and contain the space as to shelter it, give it definition, and suggest its use. ...The inside and outside have been conceived and planned as one continuous area." While deeply influenced by Wright's work and teachings, Green exhibited his own masterful and expressive architectural vocabulary in the Anderson Residence. The procession of space begins with a deeply recessed entryway. Once inside, a V-shaped plan directs sharply gabled rooflines outward in two directions; they seem to float above the living space. A private bedroom wing is to the left, and the more public spaces- living room, dining room, and kitchen- are straight ahead. Sweeping ocean views reveal themselves unexpectedly. There are areas of dramatic openness; others are more intimate and withdrawn. Two guest bedrooms and both baths face northeast towards a serene and private Japanese garden. In the primary bedroom, a wall of windows frames head-on ocean views. The apex of the room's corner opens completely to the outside by way of two monumental glass doors, and a quarried stone fireplace flanks the bedside. At the opposite end of the home, the kitchen is disguised as fine furniture, blending seamlessly with myriad built-ins throughout. From a central dining area, steps follow the contour of the land down to a sunken living room with original built-in seating and architect-designed furniture. A massive stone fireplace anchors the space, with adjacent mitered corner glass walls offering unobstructed panorama. Architect Eric Lloyd Wright oversaw a 2003 primary bath expansion, swimming pool update and spa tub addition with reverence to the harmonious design of the home and its surrounding terraces, planters, and gardens. Green revisited the home with a plan for the second owners to create two additional bedrooms and two baths with its own entryway. The addition was never built, but the architect's elegant design for its potential remains. With the adjacent canyon and Abalone Cove to the east, and several hundred feet of Pacific Ocean frontage to the south, the Anderson Residence offers an incredible degree of privacy and space. A study in serenity.

Waterfront Living in Lily Cove — “The Red House” 
Known to locals as “The Red House” and to Airbnb guests as La Maison du Lac, this beloved waterfront retreat in the Lily Cove community of Clearlake offers the rare combination of beautiful lakefront living, income-producing potential, and thoughtful updates throughout.
This 3-bedroom, 2-bath, 1,324 sq. ft. home has enjoyed a strong reputation as a successful Airbnb, with steady bookings and returning guests who have fallen in love with its waterfront setting.
Step inside to find new flooring throughout, new dual-pane windows, new dishwasher and oven, plus a new pellet stove. Beautiful brickwork surrounding the pellet stove and detailed finishes in the kitchen add warmth and character to the home.
The primary bedroom features unobstructed lake views, creating a peaceful retreat where you can wake up to the water every morning. Outside, the approximately four-year-old deck provides plenty of room for lounging, dining and entertaining, while the beautiful gazebo creates an ideal gathering spot overlooking the lake.
And then there’s the waterfront.
The pier has been redone within the last three years, along with a new Trex stairway leading down toward the gazebo, pier and boathouse. The retaining wall has also been redone, adding both function and peace of mind. A new $15,000 winch and trailer provides a convenient way to store your boat when you’re ready to step away from the water.
The attached one-car garage is currently utilized more as a storage/workshop space, providing flexibility for all your lake toys, tools and equipment. Downstairs, you’ll find an additional full bathroom along with the laundry area.

Why Lily Cove?
Lily Cove is a sought-after waterfront community known for its lakefront setting, peaceful atmosphere, easy access to the water and strong recreational appeal. Whether you’re looking for a full-time residence, weekend getaway, vacation home or an established short-term rental opportunity, this location offers the lifestyle people come to Clearlake to enjoy.
Bring your boat, your friends and your love of the water. From morning coffee overlooking the lake to evenings entertaining on the deck and gazebo, “The Red House” is more than a home—it’s a Clearlake experience.
Waterfront. Private pier. Boathouse. Lake views. Established Airbnb history. And a long list of meaningful updates.

remarks: Welcome to this charming custom-built home nestled in the quiet and sought-after Reinhardt Canyon/Maze Stone area surrounded by picturesque views of the surrounding mountains and hills on 4.71 acres. remarks:
Where Coastal Living Finds Its Rhythm

There's a rhythm to 1216 Vista Cantora, felt before it's named. This renovation didn't just chase beauty. It chased ease, the kind that lets a home fade into the background of your life so all that's left is the living.

Walk in, and the light softens against Chantilly Lace walls, warmed by engineered hardwood running room to room. Solid-core doors close with quiet weight; satin-nickel hardware catches the eye without asking for it. In the main living room, a fireplace wrapped in fluted concrete-look tile and crowned with a new mantle holds court, not loud, just present. Beyond it, sliding doors part wide enough that the pool and ocean seem to lean into the room.

The kitchen is where the house exhales. White double-Shaker cabinetry frames the perimeter, while a natural oak island anchors the center, warm, sturdy, made for gathering. Quartz counters catch the pendant light, and a vertically stacked backsplash adds quiet texture. A full Thermador suite, 36-inch range, panel-ready refrigerator, hood insert, dishwasher, waits for whatever you're in the mood to make.

Upstairs, the primary bath feels like a pause button: oak cabinetry, marble underfoot, quartz surfaces, champagne-bronze fixtures, dual showers. Just beyond it, the walk-in closet holds an open invitation, room for an island, jewelry display, dedicated lighting,  a dressing space waiting to become entirely its own.

Some of the best parts of this home you'll never see, but you'll feel them daily. A Lennox Elite system keeps the air just right through every season. A Navien tankless heater means hot water arrives the moment you ask. An EcoWater system works quietly behind the walls, protecting pipes and fixtures for years to come. Smart Thermador connectivity and an LG Sensor Dry laundry system round out a home that runs smoothly, mostly out of sight.

Then there's the yard, wood decking underfoot, a pool catching the afternoon light, landscaping that feels considered rather than manicured, and room enough for a dinner, a celebration, or nothing at all.

This isn't just a house with an ocean view. It's a place built quietly, thoughtfully, for the way life should feel,  unhurried, well-lit, and always a few steps from the water.

The Tijuana River National Estuarine Research Reserve borders the city and is one of the most significant coastal wetlands on the Pacific Coast, drawing birdwatchers and nature photographers from across the region. The Bayshore Bikeway offers miles of scenic, protected cycling along the water, connecting Imperial Beach to neighboring Coronado and beyond. For those craving a truly unique coastal experience, Border Field State Park marks the southernmost beach in the continental United States. Amenities include a staffed front desk, lush, landscaped grounds with fountains, a lit and gated dog run, subterranean parking, and an atmosphere that feels more like a boutique European hotel than condominium living. MOONRIDGE MAJESTY – LUXURIOUS MOUNTAIN RETREAT !!  
This gorgeous 2-story, 4-bedroom mountain retreat is your perfect 4-season mountain get-away for family and friends.  With one front deck and two back decks offering majestic views of the surrounding mountains, each season brings its own special delights.   Situated in a cul de sac on a 1/2 acre lot forested with native California black oaks, fir and pine trees, you will experience the tranquility and privacy that a mountain retreat should provide.

Located 1.9 miles from Bear Mountain Ski Resort you will be putting on your skis after a short 10-minute drive. Enjoy peek-a-boo views of Baldwin Lake from the top deck as this local dry basin lake fills with snowmelt during winter and spring. And if it’s hiking you like, there is no need to drive anywhere. Trailheads are easily accessed and within walking distance.  Also, don’t forget to bring your 4-wheeler to access plentiful off-roading opportunities.  
A massive oversized 2-car garage will accommodate all the toys you can bring. You may hang your hats, swimsuits, and winter clothes in the mud room just off the garage.  Here you will also find a half bath and laundry facilities.    
The beautiful, oversized kitchen is a chef’s delight, offeringstorage galore with knotty alder cabinets, a pantry, two separate sinks, granite counter tops, a pub height island that seats five+, and all stainless steel appliances. The large dining room will easily accommodate all of your guests.  
The great room is an entertainer’s delight.  Completely open to the kitchen and dining area, the cook is always part of the action.  The massive wood burning fireplace, huge mantle, and hearthare the focal point of this gathering place and perfect for hanging your stockings on!   
The expansive master bedroom is a complete retreat itself.  Features include a walk-in closet, a luxurious bathroom with a separate shower and over-sized jacuzzi tub, two sinks, and cupboards in abundance.  A beautiful, remote-controlled gas logfireplace offers extra coziness in the winter and provides a private, quiet spot to unwind from the day’s activities.

The stairs to the 2nd floor lead to a huge, 698 sq. ft. game room/loft, complete with its own mini exterior deck.  The space includes a serving bar with a granite countertop, mini-fridge, sink, and cupboards.  There is also a full-size bathroom, as well as ample room for a pool table and additional sleeping accommodations.  ?

This beautiful mid century ranch home has been lovingly cared for and recently refreshed with numerous updates, while maintaining the warmth and character that make it feel like home. The open floorplan and high ceilings fill the home with natural light, creating a comfortable and inviting living space with fresh interior and exterior paint and new carpeting throughout.

The large kitchen opens to the family room, creating an easy flow for cooking, gathering and entertaining. New kitchen appliances add to the appeal, while the spacious layout provides plenty of room for everyday living.

The spacious primary bedroom features a large walk-in closet, vanity area, updated private bathroom and sliding glass door opening directly to the backyard. Two additional bedrooms each offer generous closets and share an updated hall bathroom.

Peters Canyon and Irvine Regional Park are nearby for hiking and outdoor recreation, while South Coast Metro offers shopping, dining, theaters and concert venues.
With its comfortable living spaces, beautiful backyard and thoughtful updates, this is a home that has been truly enjoyed and is ready to be loved by its next owners.

remarks: One of the landmark estates of San Marino/Pasadena, the William K Jewett House and Gardens, also known as Arden Villa, is spread over a gated and level nearly three acres of landscaped grounds, including: The main and secondary homes, two pools, tennis court, green house, reflecting pond and expansive lawns and formal gardens. Designed by the venerable team of Sylvanus Marston & Garrett Van Pelt, and completed in 1915, the entire estate, as well as the secondary Mid-Century Modern home, with separate pool and gated driveway, underwent a massive renovation and redesign in 2019. In addition to systems and structural updates, Clements Design masterfully married existing 100+ year old handcrafted detailing, with modern amenities and design. So difficult, and rarely accomplished, the estate exudes the stalwart characteristics of the Gilded Age, at the same time feeling avant-garde, imaginative, and creative. Set behind its grand wrought iron gates, the home and gardens have provided unparalleled privacy for its residents as well as played host to a rich history of guests, including: Buster Keaton, the Marx Brothers and the Dynasty television series. Shown only to prequalified buyers.
